name: List saved query matches
description: List saved query matches Get paginated list of domain matches for one or more brand protection queries. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/brand-protection/domain/matches
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/brand-protection/domain/matches
Get paginated list of domain matches for one or more brand protection queries. When multiple query_ids are provided (comma-separated), matches are deduplicated across queries and each match includes a match_details array with per-match query metadata and individual dismissed state.
Required: account_id (path); query_id (query)
Optional: offset (query); limit (query); include_domain_id (query); include_dismissed (query); domain_search (query); orderBy (query); order (query)

name: Get queries
description: Get queries Get all saved brand protection queries for an account GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/brand-protection/domain/queries
context:

context:

Required: account_id (path)
Optional: id (query) — Optional query ID to retrieve a specific logo query; download (query) — If true, include base64-encoded image data in the response

PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/brand-protection/domain/queries/{query_id}

name: Bulk dismiss or undismiss matches
description: Bulk dismiss or undismiss matches Dismiss or undismiss multiple matches in a single request. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/brand-protection/domain/matches/bulk-dismiss
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/brand-protection/domain/matches/bulk-dismiss
Dismiss or undismiss multiple matches in a single request. Accepts either the new format (matches: [{query_id, domain_id}]) for per-query control, or the legacy format (match_ids: [number]) which dismisses for all queries sharing each match's hash. Returns per-item success/error results.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: body (body)

name: Dismiss a match
description: Dismiss a match Mark a specific domain as dismissed for a given query. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/brand-protection/queries/{query_id}/matches/{domain_id}/dismiss
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/brand-protection/queries/{query_id}/matches/{domain_id}/dismiss
Mark a specific domain as dismissed for a given query. Dismissals are per-query — dismissing a domain in one query does not affect other queries.
Required: account_id (path); query_id (path); domain_id (path)

description: Search scanned images Submit an image and find the n closest matches from the scanned images index without creating any match records. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/brand-protection/logo/search
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/brand-protection/logo/search

Required: account_id (path)

context:

name: Lookup takedown notices by domains
description: Lookup takedown notices by domains Bulk lookup of takedown notices by domain names. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/brand-protection/takedown-notices/lookup
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/brand-protection/takedown-notices/lookup
Bulk lookup of takedown notices by domain names. Returns an array of { domain, queryId, notice } entries (notice is null when no match exists). Supports optional queryId or queryIds to scope lookups per query. Uses POST to avoid URL length limits when looking up many domains. This endpoint is read-only. Domains are normalized (trimmed, lowercased) and deduplicated.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: body (body)

Required: account_id (path); query_id (path); domain_id (path)
